methods.caveats: No causal explanation is inferred. Interim prices are labelled and may be revised. Detection is descriptive, not a market-power or forecasting claim.
methods.divergence: Cross-sectional robust z-score against the same-day all-node median/MAD, confirmed by the node's own local z-score and an absolute difference.
methods.negativePrice: Daily minimum below zero is recorded as a market event, not automatically as a statistical anomaly.
methods.scope: Daily nodal mean and daily nodal minimum prices from the full M1 standardised dataset; missing node-days remain null and are never filled.
methods.severity: Type-specific 0-100 score from signal strength and event duration. Tiers: low <40, medium 40-64, high 65-84, critical >=85.
methods.spikeDrop: Robust local z-score against a trailing 30-day median/MAD, confirmed by a same-month median/MAD built only from strictly earlier dates (previous years included); with fewer than three prior same-month observations, the prior-only trailing baseline is used. A minimum absolute/relative price move is also required. No future observation enters a baseline.
methods.volatility: 14-day rolling standard deviation divided by that node's median 14-day standard deviation, requiring a minimum absolute dispersion.
